moreInformation.title: Finasteride
moreInformation.description:
Finasteride is a tablet for hair loss.
 
  • It comes in one dose for hair loss, 1 mg. 
  • You’ll normally take it once per day, with or without food.
  • It’s a long term treatment you take for several months or years.
 
Finasteride helps prevent hair loss by stopping testosterone from being converted into dihydrotestosterone (DHT). When your levels of DHT are high, it can shrink your hair follicles and cause the hair growth cycle to shorten – which can result in you losing hair over time. By reducing your levels of DHT, finasteride can help prevent any more hair loss, and even promote regrowth.
 
Finasteride is a generic medicine also known as Propecia and Proscar. They contain the same active ingredient and work in the same way, the branding and appearance can just be a little different.
 
Finasteride is different from minoxidil, another treatment for hair loss, because it’s an oral tablet. Minoxidil, sold under the brand name Regaine, comes as a solution or foam you apply to your scalp. They work a little differently, too – minoxidil helps increase blood flow to the hair follicles in your scalp, to help prevent further hair loss and encourage hair regrowth. 
 
You might be asked to provide pictures of your hair while using finasteride, to make sure your treatment is working as it should, and that it’s the right option for you.

moreInformation.title: Regaine
moreInformation.description:
Regaine is a topical solution and foam for hair loss.
 
  • It comes in one dose: 5% w/w minoxidil in either a foam or solution.
  • You’ll usually apply 1 mg to the affected area twice each day.
  • It can take at least 8 weeks of using Regaine before any new hair growth.
 
Regaine contains the active ingredient minoxidil, which is a type of vasodilator. When you apply it to the affected area, it helps to widen the blood vessels so blood can flow to your hair follicles more easily. 
 
The active ingredient in Regaine is called minoxidil, and you can sometimes get it as a generic product on its own, or alongside another hair loss treatment. Regaine is also sometimes called Rogaine, depending on where you are in the world. 
 
Regaine is different from other hair loss treatments because it comes as a topical foam or solution. If you don’t like taking tablets, and would rather apply a topical treatment each day, Regaine might be a good option for you. 
 
Your clinician might ask for pictures of your hair while using Regaine, so they can monitor your progress. If there’s no improvement after four months of treatment, your clinician can recommend alternative hair loss treatment options.

moreInformation.title: Propecia
moreInformation.description:
Propecia is a tablet for hair loss.
 
  • Propecia comes in one dose, 1 mg. 
  • You’ll usually take it once a day, either with or without food.
  • Propecia is a long term treatment you’ll take for several months or years.
 
Propecia is a branded tablet for preventing hair loss. It works by preventing testosterone from being converted into dihydrotestosterone (DHT), which is thought to contribute to hair loss. DHT is thought to be responsible for hair loss because it can shrink your hair follicles and shorten the natural hair growth cycle. This can mean you end up losing hair over time. By stopping the conversion of testosterone to DHT, Propecia can prevent any more hair loss in the future, and even help you regrow some of the hair you’ve lost.
 
Propecia contains the active ingredient finasteride. Proscar is another branded medication that contains finasteride as an active ingredient. It comes in a higher dose and is usually used to treat an enlarged prostate. 
 
Finasteride is also available as a generic medication. This means it contains the same active ingredient as branded versions like Propecia, but usually costs a bit less as it doesn’t come with the brand name.
 
Propecia is different from other hair loss medications like minoxidil because it comes as a tablet, rather than a topical foam or solution. Minoxidil is sold under the brand Regaine, and helps to widen blood vessels in your scalp to improve blood flow to hair follicles. This can help slow down and prevent hair loss, and promote your hair to grow back. 
 
While using Propecia, you might be asked for pictures of your hair to track your progress. This is so your clinician can make sure your treatment is working correctly, and suggest alternative options if it isn’t.

advised.name: Avodart
advised.excerpt: Off-label treatment for hair loss that comes as a capsule.

moreInformation.title: Avodart
moreInformation.description:
Avodart is a capsule that's prescribed off-label for hair loss.

  • It's available as one dose (0.5mg)
  • You'll take one tablet a day
  • You should start to see the results from around 3-6 months

The active ingredient in it, dutasteride, works by slowing down the conversion of testosterone to dihydrotesterone in the body. It's this hormone conversion that significantly contributes towards hair loss in men. By preventing this conversion from happening, dutasteride slows hair loss down, and for many men, encourages hair regrowth.

Avodart isn't licensed for hair loss specifically, but it has been shown to be safe and effective at treating it. So when a clinician prescribes it for this purpose, it's called an off-label use.

advised.name: Dutasteride
advised.excerpt: Off-label. Prevents hair loss and hair thinning. Comes as a capsule that's taken daily.

moreInformation.title: Dutasteride
moreInformation.description:
What is Dutasteride?

Dutasteride is a tablet that’s used to treat enlarged prostate, but it’s also used as an off-label treatment for male pattern hair loss or androgenetic alopecia. An off-label treatment means it’s not officially licensed to treat the condition you’re using it for (in this case, hair loss).

Multiple studies have shown Dutasteride’s effectiveness at treating male pattern hair loss[1], and your clinician will only prescribe it if they think it’s safe and suitable for you.

How does Dutasteride work?

Dutasteride belongs to the class of drugs called 5α-reductase inhibitors. 5α-reductase is an enzyme that converts testosterone into dihydrotestosterone (DHT). DHT is the primary hormone responsible for shrinking hair follicles, causing the hair to thin and eventually resulting in hair loss.

Dutasteride stops the conversion of testosterone into DHT by blocking 5α-reductase. This stops your hair from thinning and allows it to regrow.[2]

What doses of Dutasteride are there?

Dutasteride comes in a capsule, in one dose of 0.5mg. You’ll usually take one dose daily until you or your clinician decides to stop treatment. If you decide to stop taking it, ask your clinician about the possible consequences.
